# Game Codex (PKO Specification & AI Benchmark Suite)

> Machine-readable index for LLM Agents and AI Assistants.
> Version: 1.0.0 (2026)

## Overview
Game Codex turns game rules and mathematical decision-making into Playable Knowledge Objects (PKOs). Each object contains 6 layers: `answer`, `evidence`, `model`, `play`, `quiz`, `machine`.

## Core Documentation
- [README](https://github.com/Igor-Zinin/game-codex/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, architecture, and running instructions.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/Igor-Zinin/game-codex/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Guidelines for adding new PKOs and submitting Pull Requests.
- [PKO Specification Canon](https://github.com/Igor-Zinin/game-codex/blob/main/knowledge/pko/chess-en-passant-001.pko.json): Reference PKO implementation for En Passant.

## Live Public Interactive Site
- [Live PKO Inspector](https://igor-zinin.github.io/game-codex/docs/): Interactive web interface reading PKO objects directly at runtime.

## Machine Verification
- Self-test runner: `node selftest.mjs`
- Auditor module: `packages/auditor/auditor.mjs`
